description: The Jail Mod is a server-side mod (and singleplayer) for Minecraft (Fabric) that allows you to imprison players in a virtual prison.

mods.name: Jail Mod
mods.description: A server-side (and singleplayer) mod that allows administrators to jail players with time-based sentences and restrictions.

releases.notes:
## News

- Added `/jail list` to show jailed players, their remaining time, reason, and who jailed them.
- Added `/jail unjail` alongside `/unjail`.

## Changes 

- `/jail unjail` and `/unjail` now accept player names or UUIDs and support offline players. Offline players are released and have their saved state restored when they next join.
- `/jail set` can use your current position. Operators can always use it; access for configured admin roles can be enabled in the settings.

## Improvements

- Added Mod Menu buttons to open the client defaults config and the current world’s config files.
- Added a searchable Help tab with styled guides to settings and commands.
- Reduced repeated jail-data save messages in the console to prevent clutter.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Abdo9616/jail-mod/compare/3.1+26.3...3.3+26.3

releases.notes:
## Changes

- Added per-world settings and jail records for singleplayer worlds. Client defaults apply when creating or first opening a world.

## Improvements

- Updated jail and release chat messages with BanHammer-style colors and clearer audience-specific messages. The moderator gets a confirmation first, the affected player gets a personal message, and other players get the announcement.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Abdo9616/jail-mod/compare/3.1+26.3...3.2+26.3

releases.notes:
## Changes

- Jail reasons are now optional. Commands default to `Unknown reason`.
- Jail durations now support seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years. Abbreviations and full unit names are accepted.

## Improvements

- Jail messages display durations in readable units, such as `10 minutes` or `1 day 2 hours`.
- BanHammer-style jail announcements show player names in red, staff names in gold, and reasons and durations in yellow.
- `/jail info` shows the remaining sentence, reason, and staff member who jailed the player.
- Existing language files are updated automatically while preserving custom wording.

## Fixes

- Fixed duplicate jail announcements in chat.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Abdo9616/jail-mod/compare/3.0+26.3...3.1+26.3

releases.notes:
### Added
- Optional [BanHammer](https://github.com/Patbox/BanHammer) webhook integration: if `discord_webhook_url` is empty ( in the config.json), JailMod can reuse `config/banhammer/config.json` (`discordWebhookUrls` / `discordWebhookUrl`).
- New `config/jailmod/discord-messages.json` with BanHammer-style message templates (`jailMessage`, `unjailMessage`, `autoUnjailMessage`) and per-message toggles.
- Auto-patching for `discord-messages.json` so new fields are added on update without wiping existing user edits.
- `/jail reload` now reloads Discord message templates and webhook resolution cache.
- `/unjail` command suggestions now list jailed players only.

### Fixed
- Fixed `/unjail` behavior to show a red error when target player is not jailed.

### Notes
- BanHammer is optional; JailMod works without it.
- Goal of this update: jail actions are now reported to Discord in the same moderation-style format as BanHammer.
- Webhook URL priority is: `discord_webhook_url` first, then BanHammer fallback (only when `use_banhammer_webhook=true`).
